label: Delete
depicts: Tall trash bin outline with a narrow lid line and open inner body
use_when: Use when the interface wants the simplest trash bin with no inner slats or lid handle.
avoid_when: Do not use for the slatted or handled trash bins when the empty inner body matters.

label: Delete
depicts: Trash bin outline with a top handle cap and two inner vertical slats
use_when: Use when the interface wants a trash bin with visible inner slats and a top handle cap.
avoid_when: Do not use for the plain or empty trash bins when the two inner slats should stay visible.

label: Delete
depicts: Rounded trash bin outline with a top handle cap and blank inner body
use_when: Use when the interface wants a handled trash bin without the inner slat marks.
avoid_when: Do not use for the slatted bin when the inner body should remain blank.

label: Cross
depicts: Wide rounded cross with four equal arms and a thick center block
use_when: Use when the interface wants a balanced cross with broad equal arms and rounded corners.
avoid_when: Do not use for the slimmer vertical cross when the wide equal arm shape matters.

label: Cross
depicts: Slender cross with a long vertical stem and short horizontal bar
use_when: Use when the interface wants a taller cross with a long vertical stem rather than equal arms.
avoid_when: Do not use for the broad equal armed cross when the long vertical stem is visible.
